name: Clarity AI: ADHD Brain Dump
tagline: Turn a messy brain dump into small, doable steps.
tracking_detail: Clarity shows no ads. The first time you open the app, iOS asks whether Clarity may track you. If you tap **Allow**, Google Firebase Analytics may read your device's advertising identifier (IDFA) and link your in-app usage, purchase and diagnostic events with data from other companies, so we can measure how well our advertising brings in new users. If you tap **Ask App Not to Track**, the IDFA is not read and your data is not used to track you across other companies' apps and websites. You can change your choice at any time in iOS **Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking**.
storage_summary: Your tasks, Brain Dumps and settings are stored only on your device.

ai_consent.withdraw: Delete the app — the choice is stored only on the device, and nothing is sent to OpenAI after reinstalling until the user agrees again.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.purpose: Breaks tasks into steps, estimates how long they take, turns Brain Dumps into task lists, and summarises, rewrites or tone-checks text.
openai.data: the text you type into AI features, the text transcribed from your voice Brain Dumps, and text you share to Clarity from other apps

apple_speech.name: Apple (Speech Recognition)
apple_speech.purpose: Turns your voice into text when you record a Brain Dump.
apple_speech.data: the audio of your voice while you are recording

firebase.name: Google Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config)
firebase.purpose: Tells us which features are used, reports crashes, delivers app configuration, and — only if you allow tracking — measures our advertising.
firebase.data: in-app usage and purchase events, device model, OS version, app-generated identifiers and crash logs, plus your advertising identifier (IDFA) only if you allow tracking

data_sent.what: Tasks and text you type into AI features (task breakdown, time estimates, summaries, rewrites, tone checks)
data_sent.why: Generate the result you asked for

data_sent.what: Text transcribed from your voice Brain Dumps
data_sent.why: Turn your Brain Dump into a task list

data_sent.what: Text you share to Clarity from other apps with the Share sheet
Voice audio while you record a Brain Dump
Usage and purchase events, device model, OS version, app identifiers
data_sent.why: Understand usage and improve the app

data_sent.what: Advertising identifier (IDFA) — only if you tap **Allow** on the tracking prompt

stored_on_device: Your tasks, their steps and your time-estimate history.
Focus Mode progress and your app settings.
Summaries you create from the Share sheet, kept in the app's shared container on your device until Clarity opens them.
Your AI-consent choice and your free AI-run count.
Delete your tasks and history at any time with **Settings → Clear All Data**.
not_collected: Your name, email address or any account — the app has no sign-in.
Your voice recordings — audio is turned into text and is not saved by the app.
Your precise location, contacts, photos or browsing history.

permissions.name: Microphone and Speech Recognition
permissions.why: for voice Brain Dumps. Your voice is converted to text by Apple's speech recognition service; the text is sent to OpenAI only if you have agreed to AI data processing.

your_controls: **Withdraw AI consent** by deleting the app. The choice is stored only on your device, and after you reinstall nothing is sent to OpenAI until you agree again.
**Stop tracking** at any time in iOS **Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking**.
**Revoke Microphone or Speech Recognition access** in iOS Settings.
**Delete your tasks and history** in **Settings → Clear All Data**, or by deleting the app.

subscription.restore_location: on the Premium screen, or in Settings → Restore Purchases

support_faq.q: The AI feature asks me to agree before it works. Why?
support_faq.a: AI features send the text you type, dictate or share to OpenAI. We ask first so you know exactly what is shared. If you tap **Not Now**, nothing is sent and the AI feature does not run.

support_faq.q: Voice Brain Dump is not transcribing.
support_faq.a: Open iOS **Settings → Clarity AI** and turn on **Microphone** and **Speech Recognition**. Transcription is done by Apple's speech recognition service.

support_faq.q: Summarising from another app says to open Clarity first.
support_faq.a: Open Clarity once while you are online and agree to AI data processing. The Share sheet uses the same choice.

support_faq.q: How many AI runs are free?
support_faq.a: You can try every AI tool for free with a limited number of runs. Clarity Premium unlocks unlimited AI for every tool.

support_faq.q: How do I delete my data?
support_faq.a: Use **Settings → Clear All Data** in the app, or delete the app. Your tasks live on your device, so this removes them completely.
